Introducing the 2023 Honda CR-V Sport AWD in a dazzling white finish, paired ingeniously with all-wheel drive and an intuitive automatic transmission. Prepared to handle diverse terrains and conditions, the CR-V is designed for the adventurous at heart.

Admire its dynamic exterior featuring sleek alloy wheels and a spacious body type characterizing the essence of an SUV. Step inside to discover a meticulously crafted interior where comfort meets style, highlighted by heated seats and elegantly integrated keyless entry features. Perfectly proportioned windows and a panoramic sunroof/moonroof provide an open ambiance for every journey.

This Honda CR-V is technology-savvy with smart device integration for seamless connectivity and entertainment. Safety is paramount with a series of advanced features like a backup camera, lane assist, and brake assist systems, ensuring every drive is stress-free. Enhance your drive with the convenience of remote start, power seats, and power windows crafted for ease and luxury.

Ideal for families or individuals who value space, reliability, and modern sophistication, this SUV stands ready to fulfill your driving aspirations. Ready to take a closer look? Contact Orleans Mitsubishi today and experience the CR-V difference.

Découvrez ce Honda CR-V EX AWD 2019 de couleur charbon avec intérieur noir et 160 433 km. Un VUS polyvalent, confortable et sécuritaire, idéal pour la conduite quotidienne et les déplacements quatre saisons grâce à son rouage intégral.

Ce Honda CR-V EX AWD 2019, est équipé notamment du démarreur à distance, les vitres teintées, les phares antibrouillards, l'attache-remorque, l'aileron, l'accès et démarrage sans clé, les sièges en tissu chauffants, le siège conducteur électrique, le régulateur de vitesse adaptatif, l'assistance au maintien de voie, la caméra d'angle mort, le climatiseur automatique bizone, le toit ouvrant, le Bluetooth, la caméra de recul ainsi qu'Apple CarPlay et Android Auto.

Sur le marché, ce Honda CR-V EX AWD 2019 se compare avantageusement à des modèles comme le Toyota RAV4 XLE AWD, le Mazda CX-5 GS AWD, le Nissan Rogue SV AWD et le Subaru Forester. Dans sa catégorie, le CR-V se démarque surtout par son espace intérieur, sa fiabilité reconnue, son confort et son excellent équipement.

Disponible à l'état d'occasion chez Oliver Honda à Saint-Eustache, au service des acheteurs de Saint-Eustache, Laval, Mirabel, Blainville et de toute la région des Basses-Laurentides.

Un rapport CARFAX est inclus pour assurer une transparence complète sur l'historique du véhicule confirmant qu'un seul propriétaire et aucun accident rapporté.

Financement disponible avec des solutions adaptées à votre situation. Communiquez avec notre équipe dès aujourd'hui pour obtenir plus d'informations ou planifier un essai routier.

Discover this 2019 Honda CR-V EX AWD in charcoal with a black interior and 160,433 km. A versatile, comfortable, and safe SUV, ideal for daily driving and year-round adventures thanks to its all-wheel drive.

This 2019 Honda CR-V EX AWD is equipped with features including remote start, tinted windows, fog lights, a trailer hitch, a rear spoiler, keyless entry and start, heated cloth seats, a power driver's seat, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, a blind-spot camera, dual-zone automatic climate control, a sunroof, Bluetooth, a rearview camera, and Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility.

On the market, this 2019 Honda CR-V EX AWD compares favorably to models such as the Toyota RAV4 XLE AWD, the Mazda CX-5 GS AWD, the Nissan Rogue SV AWD, and the Subaru Forester. In its class, the CR-V stands out primarily for its interior space, renowned reliability, comfort, and excellent features.

Available as a pre-owned vehicle at Oliver Honda in Saint-Eustache, serving buyers in Saint-Eustache, Laval, Mirabel, Blainville, and throughout the Lower Laurentians region.

A CARFAX report is included to ensure complete transparency regarding the vehicle's history, confirming only one owner and no reported accidents.

With an all-wheel-drive system, this incredibly versatile and practical SUV features heated front seats, 60-40 folding split-bench rear seats, proximity keyless entry with push button start, adaptive cruise control, dual-zone climate control, remote engine start, and a refreshed 7-inch infotainment system with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and Siri Eyes Free. At Myers Barrhaven Toyota we pride ourselves in offering highly desirable pre-owned vehicles. We truly hand pick all our vehicles to offer only the best vehicles to our customers. Every year we evaluate 1000's of vehicles and only 10-15% meet the Myers Barrhaven Toyota standards. At the end of the day we have mutual interest in selling only the best as we back all our pre-owned vehicles with the Myers *LIFETIME ENGINE TRANSMISSION warranty. That's right *LIFETIME ENGINE TRANSMISSION warranty, we're in this together! If we don't have what you're looking for not to worry, our experienced buyer can help you find the car of your dreams! Ever heard of getting top dollar for your trade but not really sure if you were? Here we leave nothing to chance, every trade-in we appraise goes up onto a live online auction and we get buyers coast to coast and in the USA trying to bid for your trade. This means we simultaneously expose your car to 1000's of buyers to get you top trade in value.
We service all makes and models in our new state of the art facility where you can enjoy the convenience of our on-site restaurant, shuttle van, free Wi-Fi, Enterprise Rent-A-Car, on-site tire storage, and complimentary drinks. Come see why many Toyota owners are making the switch to Myers Barrhaven Toyota.
